next: A WHOLE HOUSE ON A LORRY

segments.text: You're waiting at a red light. Then it goes yellow. And green. All at the same time.
Then it starts to blink. Music. A mirror ball. The traffic light has turned into a disco. What do you do?
Most drivers think: honk, until it stops.
Big mistake. The traffic light thinks you're cheering. Volume up! The bass is so strong, your car starts to bounce.
Higher, and higher. Until you land on top of the traffic light. Spinning. You're the new mirror ball.
Here's how you do it properly.
Every disco needs a light show. Hazard lights on.
Blink to the beat. Left. Right. Left.
The other drivers join in. Headlights flashing, everybody swaying. The whole junction is dancing.
The traffic light is so happy, it gives everybody green. At once.
So you all drive off together. One big conga line, once around, and out.
Next exam question: a whole house on a lorry comes towards you. Follow, so you don't miss it.
